fusions.name: Spore Drift
fusions.desc: Sheds a ring of spores, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving each [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Root Rot
fusions.desc: A rotting blow that deals 16 damage and draws out every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more damage for each one drawn. It leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Mulch Bed
fusions.desc: Raises a bed of loam where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Spreading Mat
fusions.desc: A bonded mat of mycelium keeps pace with you, striking enemies within 4.5 tiles for 3 damage every 1.4 seconds, slowing each one by 20% for 2 seconds and leaving it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.
